We’ve been working on two parallel tracks throughout this journey. On the project side, we continue to support our pilots with the goal of converting them into deals. At the same time, we are conducting market research to deepen our understanding of customer needs, market gaps, and where we can create the most value. That is, current PoCs might not be the end-goal depending on market research results.

The incubator provides us with a valuable forum to step back, reflect, and challenge our thinking—particularly when it comes to understanding the market. The most valuable people we are looking to connect with are mentors who can help us navigate this process, while also supporting us in defining the roles we want to take within the company and how we can grow into those roles.

By December 10th, our goal is to have a clear market thesis and company strategy that we can confidently stand behind and present to investors. Just as importantly, we aim to have opened doors to the key people and networks we need to make that strategy successful.
